{{Quote|What did he say, sir?"<br />"Him...? He said... One battle, one Jedi.|A clone trooper and the ARC commander, discussing Plo Koon's parting words|<ref name="One Battle" />}}
An [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] '''commander''' participated in the [[Battle of Aridka]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Protecting a city from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander's]] force consisted of only a handful of clone troopers and [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando (Aridka)|another ARC trooper]]. When the clones' defense field was obliterated, the clones made their last stand, but received last minute support from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. With the commander's help, Koon destroyed several [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], and ultimately won the battle. Koon left the clones shortly after their victory.<ref name="One Battle" />
